title: Who Benefits from Hazardous Waste Cleanups? Evidence from the Housing Market
Racial Dynamics of Federal Property Buyouts in Flood-Prone Areas
abstract: The use of managed retreats, or "buyouts," of flood-prone properties is likely to grow as an adaptation response to increasing flood risks. This paper investigates the role of race and ethnicity in buyout bargaining outcomes and how those outcomes affect longer-run neighborhood change. We combine nationwide administrative data on federal property acquisitions, housing sales transactions, and restricted-use Census microdata to estimate whether there are systematic differences by race in buyout payments relative to a property's fair market value. We then use a database tracking individual movement over time to examine the quality of the neighborhoods to which participants move and how neighborhood outcomes vary by race and program participation. We find that the buyout compensation received by households of color is at least 6 percent lower than that received by white households. White participants relocate to higher quality neighborhoods and are better off than white nonparticipants. Black participants, on the other hand, move to worse neighborhoods and are worse off than Black non-participants. Our work highlights how government policy, aimed to address increasing climate impacts, may exacerbate the burden of climate change on vulnerable communities.
abstract_zh: 对易受洪水侵袭的房产实施有计划的撤离（即“收购”，buyout），作为应对日益加剧的洪水风险的适应性举措，其使用可能会增加。本文考察了种族和族裔在收购谈判结果中所起的作用，以及这些结果如何影响长期的社区变迁。我们结合了全国性的联邦房产收购行政数据、住房销售交易数据以及受限使用的人口普查微观数据，以检验在收购补偿相对于房产公平市场价值方面，是否存在按种族划分的系统性差异。随后，我们利用一个追踪个人迁移的数据库，考察参与者迁入社区的质量，以及社区结果如何因种族和是否参与项目而异。我们发现，有色人种家庭获得的收购补偿至少比白人家庭低6%。白人参与者迁往质量更高的社区，且境况优于未参与的白人。另一方面，黑人参与者迁往质量更差的社区，且境况劣于未参与的黑人。我们的研究表明，旨在应对日益加剧的气候影响的政府政策，可能会加重气候变化对弱势社区的负担。

title: A Spatially-differentiated Water Pollution Policy Leads to Economic and Health Inequity
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
abstract: Disparities in air pollution exposure by socioeconomic status (SES) are well documented. However, there is much less evidence on the inequitable consequences of water pollution and policies affecting water pollution gaps. This study uncovers the distributional impact of China’s 11th Five-Year Plan (2006–2010), which triggered spatially differentiated water pollution abatement for a population of almost 1.3 billion. We document that the policy reduced water pollution overall, targeting areas based on pollution level. Since high pollution areas tend to be wealthier, this policy concentrated firm water pollution abatement and reductions in polluting firm entry in higher-SES areas. While pollution fell, the policy further widened the gap in health and economic outcomes, particularly for those without tap water access: Disparities in risks of tumor, cardiovascular disease, labor supply, and wages increased. Our findings demonstrate that policy-induced changes in water pollution can interact with unequal access to defensive infrastructure to exacerbate SES gaps in outcomes. The analysis also suggests that consideration of heterogeneous pollution vulnerability across the population may affect the overall benefits of a policy.
abstract_zh: 按社会经济地位（SES）划分的空气污染暴露差异已有充分记录。然而，关于水污染以及影响水污染差距的政策所带来的不平等后果，证据则少得多。本研究揭示了中国“十一五”规划（2006–2010年）的分配影响，该规划针对约13亿人口，实施了空间差异化的水污染治理。我们记录到，该政策总体上降低了水污染，并依据污染水平锁定目标地区。由于高污染地区往往更为富裕，该政策将企业水污染治理及污染企业进入的减少集中于社会经济地位较高的地区。尽管污染有所下降，该政策却进一步扩大了健康与经济结果的差距，尤其是对于那些无法获得自来水的人群：肿瘤、心血管疾病风险、劳动供给和工资方面的差距均有所扩大。我们的研究结果表明，政策引起的水污染变化，可能与获得防御性基础设施的不平等相互作用，从而加剧社会经济地位差距在结果上的表现。分析还表明，考虑人群中异质性的污染脆弱性，可能会影响政策的总体效益。

title: Environmental Justice: The Experience of the United States
venue: The Elsevier Encyclopedia of Resource, Energy, and Environmental Economics

title: Impacts of the SDWA Arsenic Rule on Arsenic Occurrence in U.S. Drinking Water
Foreign Competition and U.S. Facility Emissions: Margins of Adjustment
abstract: We analyze the effect of rising international competition on pollution emissions of U.S. manufacturing facilities. We first show that regions of the U.S. more exposed to increased Chinese imports during the period 1990 to 2014 also saw large increases in air quality. We then show that this decline in emissions primarily occurred on the extensive margin. Specifically, increased foreign competition led to a disproportionately high rate of exit of dirty firms, not only in more impacted industries, but also in more exposed regions. In addition, we find some evidence that increased import competition also led to cleaner environmental behavior among the surviving domestic facilities.
abstract_zh: 我们分析了国际竞争加剧对美国制造业工厂污染排放的影响。我们首先表明，在1990年至2014年间，受中国进口冲击较大的美国地区，其空气质量也大幅改善。随后，我们表明，这种排放下降主要发生在扩展边际（extensive margin）上。具体而言，外国竞争的加剧导致高污染企业的退出率不成比例地上升，这不仅发生在受影响更严重的行业，也发生在暴露程度更高的地区。此外，我们发现一些证据表明，进口竞争的加剧也促使存活下来的国内工厂采取了更清洁的环境行为。

title: Cumulative Impacts in Environmental Justice: Insights from Economics and Policy
Race and Concern for the Environment
abstract: We use survey data to document a strong heterogeneity in stated degrees of concern about environmental problems across racial groups. Minorities are significantly more worried about pollution than their white counterparts, even after controlling for socioeconomic factors and pollution exposure. Our finding implies that residential sorting based on heterogeneous financial resources and heterogeneous levels of environmental concern is unlikely to be the only driver of uneven exposure to pollution across racial groups.
abstract_zh: 我们利用调查数据，记录了不同种族群体在表达对环境问题的关注程度方面存在的显著异质性。即使在控制了社会经济因素和污染暴露之后，少数族裔对污染的担忧程度仍显著高于白人。我们的发现表明，基于异质性财务资源和异质性环境关注程度的居住分异，不太可能是造成各种族群体污染暴露不均的唯一驱动因素。

title: Risk Disclosure and Home Prices: Evidence from California Wildfire Hazard Zones
abstract: Damages from wildfires have increased dramatically in recent years. This study uses a boundary discontinuity design to estimate the effect of wildfire hazard disclosure on house prices. Using the universe of single-family sales transactions from the Zillow ZTRAX program in California from 2015 through 2022, we find that, on average, homes that faced disclosure requirements sold for approximately 4.3 percent less than nearby homes that did not. Price impacts are higher in recent years, following several damaging wildfires. Our findings highlight the use of disclosure regulations to ensure that disaster risks are reflected in housing markets.
abstract_zh: 近年来，野火造成的损失急剧增加。本研究利用边界断点设计，估计野火灾害披露对房价的影响。利用2015年至2022年间加利福尼亚州Zillow ZTRAX项目中全部单户住宅销售交易数据，我们发现，平均而言，受披露要求约束的房屋，其售价比附近未受约束的房屋低约4.3%。在若干起造成严重破坏的野火之后，近年来的价格影响更大。我们的研究结果凸显了利用披露法规，确保灾害风险能够反映在住房市场中的重要性。

title: Racial Gaps in Federal Flood Buyout Compensations
abstract: In a managed retreat, or “buyout,” program, homeowners are offered their property's fair-market value to relocate from a flood-prone area. Using a nationwide sample of federal buyout acquisitions and the universe of US housing transactions over the last two decades, we estimate whether the discount in buyout price compensation, calculated using a hedonic prediction model, depends on a homeowner's race. We provide the first systematic evidence of inequitable compensation in a federal buyout program using nationwide administrative data. Disproportionate compensation, in an attempt to adapt to a warming climate, may further widen the wealth and social mobility gaps.
abstract_zh: 在“收购”（buyout，即有计划撤离）项目中，业主会获得其房产的公平市场价值，以便从易受洪水侵袭的地区迁出。我们利用全国范围内的联邦收购样本以及过去二十年间美国住房交易的全部数据，通过享乐预测模型估计收购补偿中的折扣是否取决于业主的种族。我们首次利用全国性行政数据，为联邦收购项目中存在不公平补偿提供了系统性证据。为适应气候变暖而产生的不成比例的补偿，可能会进一步扩大财富差距和社会流动性差距。

title: Drinking Water, Fracking, and Infant Health
The (Alleged) Environmental and Social Benefits of Dynamic Pricing
venue: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
abstract: This paper provides a cautionary tale about claiming environmental costs and benefits when justifying the use of public funds. Using the example of a dynamic pricing policy, we show that the resulting impact on short-term operating costs and emissions is at best ambiguous. Moreover, it is hard to quantify even in ideal scenarios where data is plentiful and the behavioral response can be estimated precisely using a randomized control trial of customers of an electric utility. While dynamic pricing has been touted as a means to control generation costs and pollution, price-induced reallocation of electricity consumption within a day may actually increase net emissions depending on the source-generation mix of a region.
abstract_zh: 本文就在论证公共资金使用的合理性时宣称环境成本与收益这一做法，提供了一个警示性案例。以动态定价政策为例，我们表明其对短期运营成本和排放的影响至多是模糊不清的。此外，即便在理想情形下（即数据充足，且利用电力公司客户的随机对照试验能够精确估计行为反应），量化这一影响仍然十分困难。尽管动态定价一直被宣传为控制发电成本和污染的手段，但取决于一个地区的发电能源结构，价格诱导下的日内用电重新分配实际上可能会增加净排放。

title: Economic, Environmental, and Health Impacts of the Fracking Boom
abstract: The shale gas boom revolutionized the energy sector through hydraulic fracturing (fracking). High levels of energy production force communities, states, and nations to consider the externalities and potential risks associated with this unconventional oil and natural gas development (UOGD). In this review, we systematically outline the environmental, economic, and anthropogenic impacts of UOGD, while also considering the diverse methodological approaches to these topics. We summarize the current status and conclusions of the academic literature, in both economic and related fields, while also providing suggested avenues for future research. Causal inference will continue to be important for the evaluation of UOGD costs and benefits. We conclude that current economic, global, and health forces may require researchers to revisit outcomes in the face of a potential shale bust.
abstract_zh: 水力压裂热潮的经济、环境与健康影响。页岩气热潮通过水力压裂（即“水力压裂”）彻底改变了能源行业。高水平的能源生产迫使社区、州和国家考虑这种非常规石油和天然气开发（UOGD）所带来的外部性和潜在风险。在本综述中，我们系统梳理了UOGD的环境、经济和人为影响，并考虑了这些议题的多种方法路径。我们总结了经济学及相关领域学术文献的现状与结论，同时提出了未来研究的建议方向。因果推断将继续对评估UOGD的成本与收益具有重要意义。我们的结论是，当前的经济、全球和健康形势可能要求研究人员在可能出现的页岩气衰退背景下，重新审视相关结局。

title: Rural Light Pollution from Shale Gas Development and Associated Sleep and Subjective Well-Being
The Fracking Concern with Water Quality

title: Environmental Justice and Coasean Bargaining
Environmental Justice: Establishing Causal Relationships
abstract: The environmental justice literature has found that the poor and people of color are disproportionately exposed to pollution. This literature has sparked a broad activist movement and several policy reforms in the United States and internationally. In this article, we review the literature documenting correlations between pollution and demographics and the history of the related movement, focusing on the United States. We then turn to the potential causal mechanisms behind the observed correlations. Given its focus on causal econometric models, we argue that economics has a comparative advantage in evaluating these mechanisms. We consider ( a) profit-maximizing decisions by firms, ( b) Tiebout-like utility-maximizing decisions by households in the presence of income disparities, ( c) Coasean negotiations between both sides, ( d) political economy explanations and governmental failures, and ( e) intergenerational transmission of poverty. Proper identification of the causal mechanisms underlying observed disproportionate exposures is critical to the design of effective policy to remedy them.
abstract_zh: 环境正义文献发现，贫困人口和有色人种不成比例地暴露于污染之中。这一文献在美国乃至国际上引发了广泛的社会运动，并推动了若干政策改革。在本文中，我们回顾了记录污染与人口特征之间相关性的文献以及相关运动的历史，重点关注美国。随后，我们转向可能导致观察到的相关性的潜在因果机制。鉴于经济学关注因果计量经济模型，我们认为经济学在评估这些机制方面具有比较优势。我们考虑了：（a）企业的利润最大化决策；（b）在收入差距存在的情况下，类似蒂布特（Tiebout）模型的家庭效用最大化决策；（c）双方之间的科斯式谈判；（d）政治经济学解释与政府失灵；以及（e）贫困的代际传递。正确识别导致不成比例暴露的因果机制，对于设计有效的补救政策至关重要。

title: Environmental Justice: The Economics of Race, Place, and Pollution
abstract: The grassroots movement that placed environmental justice issues on the national stage around 1980 was soon followed up by research documenting the correlation between pollution and race and poverty. This work has established inequitable exposure to nuisances as a stylized fact of social science. In this paper, we review the environmental justice literature, especially where it intersects with work by economists. First we consider the literature documenting evidence of disproportionate exposure. We particularly consider the implications of modeling choices about spatial relationships between polluters and residents, and about conditioning variables. Next, we evaluate the theory and evidence for four possible mechanisms that may lie behind the patterns seen: disproportionate siting on the firm side, “coming to the nuisance” on the household side, market-like coordination of the two, and discriminatory politics and/or enforcement. We argue that further research is needed to understand how much weight to give each mechanism. Finally, we discuss some policy options.
abstract_zh: 1980年前后，基层运动将环境正义问题推上了全国舞台，随后的研究记录了污染与种族和贫困之间的相关性。这项工作已将不平等的污染暴露确立为社会科学中的一个程式化事实。在本文中，我们回顾环境正义文献，尤其是其与经济学家工作交叉的部分。首先，我们考察记录不成比例暴露的文献。我们特别考虑了关于污染者与居民之间空间关系的建模选择，以及关于条件变量的选择所带来的影响。接下来，我们评估四种可能隐藏在所观察到的规律背后的机制的理论与证据：企业一方的不成比例选址；家庭一方的“迁入污染源”（coming to the nuisance）；两者之间类似市场的协调；以及歧视性的政治和/或执法。我们认为，需要进一步研究来确定每种机制应赋予多大的权重。最后，我们讨论了若干政策选择。

title: Flood Risk and Salience: New Evidence from the Sunshine State
abstract:
A growing literature finds evidence that flood risk salience varies over time, spiking directly following a flood and then falling off individuals' cognitive radar in the following years. In this article, we provide new evidence of salience exploiting a hurricane cluster impacting Florida that was preceded and followed by periods of unusual calm. Utilizing residential property sales across the state from 2002 through 2012, our main estimate finds a salience impact of −8%, on average. The salience effect persists when we base estimation only on spatial variation in prices to limit confounding from other simultaneous changes due to shifting hedonic equilibria over time. These effects range from housing prices decreases of 5.4–12.3% depending on the year of sale. Understanding flood risk salience has important implications for flood insurance and disaster policy, the benefits transfer literature, and, more broadly, our understanding of natural disaster resilience.
JEL Classification: Q51, Q54, R21
abstract_zh:
越来越多的文献发现，洪水风险的显著性会随时间变化：洪水发生后显著性急剧上升，随后在接下来的几年里逐渐淡出人们的认知视野。在本文中，我们利用佛罗里达州一系列飓风事件（之前和之后都是异常平静的时期）提供了关于显著性的新证据。利用2002年至2012年全州的住宅房产交易数据，我们的主要估计显示，平均而言，显著性效应为−8%。当估计仅基于空间上的价格变异（以限制因随时间推移的特征价格均衡变化而带来的其他同期变化所造成的混杂）时，这一效应依然存在。根据交易年份的不同，这些效应对应的房价下降幅度为5.4%至12.3%。理解洪水风险的显著性，对洪水保险和灾害政策、效益转移文献，以及更广泛地对自然灾害韧性的理解，都具有重要意义。
JEL分类：Q51, Q54, R21

title: Learning in a Hedonic Framework: Valuing Brownfield Remediation
User Responses to Imperfect Forecasts: Findings from an Experiment with Kentucky Wheat Farmers
abstract: Weather and climate forecasts can help agricultural producers improve management choices in anticipation of uncertain growing conditions. Current literature conjectures that the extent to which forecasts are useful depends on their accuracy, that is, the probability with which a forecasted event, such as precipitation, is projected to occur. Too little accuracy can potentially render forecasts effectively useless, even if they convey some form of information. In this study, we collect farmer-based data through a questionnaire and a framed field experiment to test for the existence of an accuracy threshold for forecasts, below which forecasts do not induce any behavioral changes. We do this in the context of a very specific management choice—the timing and amount of nitrogen that Kentucky farmers apply to their wheat in early spring—in response to randomly generated 6-to-10-day forecasts of rainfall conditions. We find that forecasts provide economically significant value to decision-makers only when they depart dramatically from what is normally expected. These results have implications that extend beyond the nitrogen-application decision for winter wheat: if this type of behavior is widespread, at current accuracy levels, other types of forecasts may be of little value to decision-makers and therefore go unheeded.
abstract_zh: 天气和气候预报有助于农业生产者在面对不确定的生长条件时，改善管理决策。现有文献推测，预报的有用程度取决于其准确性，即某一预报事件（如降水）被预测发生的概率。准确性过低可能使预报实际上毫无用处，即使它传递了某种信息。在本研究中，我们通过问卷调查和框架化田间实验收集了农民数据，以检验预报是否存在一个准确性阈值，低于该阈值时预报不会引起任何行为改变。我们是在一个非常具体的管理选择背景下进行的：肯塔基州小麦种植者在早春时节，根据随机生成的6至10天降雨预报，决定施氮的时间和数量。我们发现，只有当预报与通常预期发生显著偏离时，预报才能为决策者提供具有经济意义的价值。这些结果的意义超出了冬小麦施氮决策本身：如果这种行为具有普遍性，那么在当前的准确性水平下，其他类型的预报对决策者而言可能价值甚微，从而被忽视。

title: Use of Property Values and Location Decisions for Environmental Valuation
venue: Oxford Research Encyclopedia of Environmental Science
abstract:
The economics literature has developed various methods to recover the values for environmental commodities. Two such methods related to revealed preference are property value hedonic models and equilibrium sorting models. These strategies employ the actual decisions that households make in the real estate market to indirectly measure household demand for environmental quality. The hedonic method decomposes the equilibrium price of a house based on the house’s structural and neighborhood/environmental characteristics to recover marginal willingness to pay (MWTP). The more recent equilibrium sorting literature estimates environmental values by combining equilibrium housing outcomes with a formal model of the residential choice process. The two predominant frameworks of empirical sorting models that have been adopted in the literature are the vertical pure characteristics model (PCM) and the random utility model (RUM). Along with assumptions on the structure of preferences, a formal model of the choice process on the demand side, and a characterization of the supply side to close the model, these sorting models can predict outcomes that allow for re-equilibration of prices and endogenous attributes following a counterfactual policy change.
Innovations to the hedonic model have enabled researchers to more aptly value environmental goods in the face of complications such as non-marginal changes (i.e., identification and endogeneity concerns with respect to recovering the entire demand curve), non-stable hedonic equilibria, and household dynamic behavior. Recent advancements in the sorting literature have also allowed these models to accommodate consumer dynamic behavior, labor markets considerations, and imperfect information. These established methods to estimate demand for environmental quality are a crucial input into environmental policymaking. A better understanding of these models, their assumptions, and the potential implications on benefit estimates due to their assumptions would allow regulators to have more confidence in applying these models’ estimates in welfare calculations.
abstract_zh:
经济学文献已发展出多种方法，用以揭示环境商品的价值。与显示性偏好相关的两种方法是房产价值特征价格模型（hedonic models）和均衡分类模型（equilibrium sorting models）。这些策略利用家庭在房地产市场中的实际决策，间接衡量家庭对环境质量的需求。特征价格法将房屋的均衡价格分解为房屋结构特征和邻里/环境特征，从而揭示边际支付意愿（MWTP）。较新的均衡分类文献，则通过将均衡住房结果与住宅选择过程的正式模型相结合，来估计环境价值。文献中采用的两种主要的分类模型框架，是纵向纯特征模型（PCM）和随机效用模型（RUM）。除了偏好结构的假设、需求侧选择过程的正式模型，以及为封闭模型而对供给侧的刻画之外，这些分类模型还能预测在反事实政策变化之后，价格与内生属性重新达到均衡的结果。
特征价格模型的创新，使研究人员能够更恰当地评估环境商品，以应对诸如非边际变化（即为恢复整条需求曲线所面临的识别与内生性问题）、非稳定的特征价格均衡以及家庭动态行为等复杂情况。分类文献的最新进展，也使这些模型能够纳入消费者的动态行为、劳动力市场因素以及不完全信息。这些成熟的环境质量需求估计方法，是环境政策制定的关键投入。更好地理解这些模型、其假设，以及假设对效益估计可能产生的影响，将使监管者在将这些模型的估计结果应用于福利计算时更有信心。

title: Shale Gas Development and Drinking Water Quality
venue: American Economic Review: Papers and Proceedings
abstract: Recent studies have linked shale gas development (SGD) to ground water contamination. The extent of these environmental externalities, to date, remains uncertain. To address this gap, we examine whether shale gas development systematically affects drinking water quality by creating a novel dataset that relates SGD to public drinking water samples in Pennsylvania. Our difference-in-differences strategy finds evidence that additional well pads drilled within 1 kilometer of a community water system intake increases shale gas-related contaminants in drinking water. These results are striking considering that our data are based on water sampling measurements taken after municipal treatment.
abstract_zh: 页岩气开发与饮用水质量。近期研究已将页岩气开发（SGD）与地下水污染联系起来。迄今为止，这些环境外部性的程度仍不确定。为弥补这一空白，我们构建了一个新的数据集，将SGD与宾夕法尼亚州的公共饮用水采样数据相联系，考察页岩气开发是否系统性地影响饮用水质量。我们的双重差分策略发现，在社区供水系统取水口1公里范围内每新增一个井场，都会增加饮用水中与页岩气相关的污染物。考虑到我们的数据基于市政处理后的水样测量，这些结果尤为引人注目。
